scope: Mode capability inventory; implementation tests do not imply a live observation, broker authorization, or profitable strategy.

modes.capability: Read-only Kite Connect quote and historical-data adapters normalize source clocks, quote fidelity, and available depth.
modes.tested_mode: Mocked provider contract tests; no fresh authorized market capture evidenced.
modes.fidelity: Adapter and payload fidelity tested; live source freshness and request latency unverified.
limitations: LTP-only observations cannot support executable fills.
No current live quote evidence or independently attested session.

modes.capability: Run deterministic synthetic fixtures and historical datasets through research and replay workflows.
modes.tested_mode: FIXTURE_REPLAY and historical replay unit suites.
modes.fidelity: Fixture outcomes are synthetic; historical replay is limited by source coverage and modeled execution.
limitations: Replay is not prospective evidence and cannot be relabeled as live paper.

modes.capability: Evaluate signals without producing fills or sending physical orders.
modes.tested_mode: SHADOW mode unit contract; no observed market session recorded in this artifact.
modes.fidelity: Mode and no-fill guarantees are tested; actual feed continuity and shadow coverage are not evidenced.
limitations: No shadow-session opportunity denominator or independent timestamp evidence is attached.

modes.capability: Run simulated orders through durable OMS/accounting paper books and persist marked NAV snapshots.
modes.tested_mode: LOCAL_PAPER and deterministic replay tests; active local paper database was not inspected as outcome evidence.
modes.fidelity: Paper accounting and quote contracts are tested; actual captured sessions and fill realism are not independently verified.
limitations: Long-only, single-currency cash accounting; margin and derivatives are not included.
No independently attested completed live-market session is evidenced.

modes.capability: Mode resolver requires verified broker compliance before a dry-run session can be granted.
modes.tested_mode: Negative test confirms grant is refused without a verified compliance record.
modes.fidelity: Gate behavior tested; no broker dry-run adapter or rehearsal was observed.
limitations: No authorized broker rehearsal or reconciled broker status.

modes.capability: Physical order policy is hard-disabled; mode grant fails closed even if a runtime flag is forged.
modes.tested_mode: Forged build flag and missing-approval negative tests; no physical order route exists in the paper kernel.
modes.fidelity: Disablement and authorization-gate behavior tested; no live orders were sent.
limitations: Live cash is not approved or enabled.
